description: This file defines the DefaultShapeFactory class, which implements dynamic shape creation and management within the OrchardCore display management system. It handles shape instantiation, event invocation, and shape table retrieval.

classes.name: DefaultShapeFactory
classes.description: A dynamic object and shape factory responsible for creating and managing shapes asynchronously, with event handling and shape table management.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Provides access to the factory instance itself.

methods.name: TryInvokeMember
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, supporting async shape creation via method invocation.

methods.name: GetShapeTableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the shape table asynchronously, caching it for subsequent calls.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a shape of a specified type, invoking creation and creation events, and merging shape metadata.
